annotations.title: States by payday loan status or payment-plan rule

description: Lists states (50 plus DC) by their payday loan rules as published on paydayloan.help: filter by status (allowed with limits, installment-only, or typical payday loans not allowed), by whether state law requires an extended payment plan, or by a list of state codes to compare. Each row gives the status, a one-paragraph summary, the payment-plan flag, research confidence and the state page link.

payment_plan_required.description: true = only states whose law requires lenders to offer an extended payment plan; false = only states that do not.

status.description: allowed = payday loans allowed with limits; allowed-installment-only = only longer installment-style loans; not-allowed = typical payday loans not allowed.
